text:
Minutes of a staff meeting of the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Attendees: Aurelia, Lucas Rivera, Ravi Adeyemi, Poppy, and the senior coordinator.

The senior coordinator opened the meeting with an urgent welfare review. The welcome team briefed passengers in concise, kind, and actionable language, then verified that companion animal documentation and comfort instructions were easy to follow at boarding. The welfare coordinator emphasized that the travel desk must treat comfort controls as operational safety controls, with clear ownership and traceable checks.

We reviewed the current cabin climate control standard for pet welfare. Entity Moonwake is maintained at 17 degrees Celsius so the pet cabin stays at this temperature for comfort. The quality auditor notes that staff must confirm reading accuracy before each boarding cycle and record any deviation without delay, because temperature drift directly affects stress levels and mobility.

Next, we assessed capacity management and load planning. Entity Halcyon is configured to hold 64 pets so the pet cabin reaches its planned occupancy level. The team agreed that acceptance decisions must align with cabin holding limits, and that any mismatch between expected arrivals and actual bookings requires immediate escalation to prevent overcrowding, access blockages, and inadequate rest space.

Lucas Rivera and Ravi Adeyemi described their observations during boarding flow. Poppy remained calm through the handoff process, and the travelers reported that the guidance was clear and focused on immediate actions. The welcome team reiterated that handlers should minimize exposure time during transfers and keep carriers stable and secure.

The senior coordinator assigned immediate follow-ups. The welcome team will tighten the pre-boarding checklist language so passengers receive only critical steps, and the welfare coordinator will conduct a comfort audit using a consistent observation template focused on noise sensitivity, breathing comfort, and recovery after handling. The quality auditor will monitor whether staff comply with the recording expectations and whether escalations occur within the required window.

Meeting ended.
